facets.description: FallbackLocaleList#[] (i18n.rb line 17) calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym with no guard, and .compact runs too late, so a nil or unavailable default locale raises on every translation or request
The String I18n.locale is mixed with Symbol locales, so .uniq doesn't remove the duplicate 'en' and :en entries and en.yml is loaded twice
